unconfirmed_or_absent: No confirmed explosion, particle burst, full-screen flash, ongoing marker pulse, concentric pulse rings, leader-line reveal, or route animation.
No measured marker overshoot above settled size; only growth, brief dip, rebound/settle is visible.
Place-label disappearance follows camera leaving frame; fade-out is not supported.
Country and local fill entrance cannot be isolated from cut/camera reveal.
Glow hue and pin shape are observations only; not implementation assets/design/color recommendations.
Acoustic peaks do not establish an isolated effect sound.

minimal_pattern_recommendation.marker: One one-shot location marker entrance of ~0.35–0.5s: grow, small dip, settle; world/geography anchored. No repeated pulse.
minimal_pattern_recommendation.text: Preserve CURRENT existing fades and typography. Optional brief entrance scale emphasis on existing factual text; no typewriter required.
minimal_pattern_recommendation.highlight: Boundary draw is supported only for an actual boundary/measurement fact. Do not add arbitrary route/glow to camera move.

mapping_to_current_fixed_contract.recommendation: Optional single geography-anchored marker grow/dip/settle at cue, ending by~2.5s. Keep current label fade timing.

mapping_to_current_fixed_contract.recommendation: Keep current cross. Optional small one-shot text emphasis, no additional location pin or repeated pulse.
